What can you do on this tab?
The order below follows the flow the donor sees in the popup: heading and close first, then the box and fields, and finally the form buttons and the on-page trigger button.
Window width and padding are on the “Popup & form layout” tab; this tab covers the popup’s inner color, texts, and buttons.
If “Multiple shares” or “Progress bar” is on in the product card, some settings live on the share/progress tabs.

Multi-step form
When on, the form moves step by step. Share-based: Shares → Confirm. Standard/Progress: Details → Amount → (Add-on donation) → Confirm. The progress bar always stays at the top.
Enable the multi-step form
Use a step-by-step flow in the popup and inline forms
When off, the form stays on a single screen in the classic layout.
Quick amount buttons
Shows one-click buttons above the amount box only on “Custom amount (donor enters)” and “Goal campaign” forms. When off, only the amount field is shown.
Show quick amount buttons
One-click buttons such as $#N# / $#N# above the amount box.
Quick amount buttons
Whole numbers only; separate with commas, spaces, or semicolons, at most #N# values (e.g. #N#, #N#, #N#, #N#, #N#). "#AMT#" or "#AMT#" is invalid. Buttons below the product’s minimum amount are not shown. The “Suggested” label comes only from the Suggested amount field on the product card.

Button shadow (plugin buttons only)
Two groups: (#N#) shortcode/trigger buttons on the page — CSS `--wdp-plugin-btn-shadow-sc`; (#N#) all other plugin buttons inside the popup and inline form — `--wdp-plugin-btn-shadow-modal`. Close (X) and quick amount buttons are excluded.
